description: This file defines classes and methods for handling certificate errors within a network security context, including error reporting, severity levels, and debug string generation.

classes.name: CertError
classes.description: Represents a single certificate error with severity, ID, and optional parameters.

classes.name: CertErrors
classes.description: A collection of CertError instances, supporting addition, querying, and debug string generation.

classes.name: CertPathErrors
classes.description: Manages errors associated with a chain of certificates, including per-certificate and general errors.

methods.name: AppendLinesWithIndentation
methods.description: Appends each line of a text with specified indentation to an output string.

methods.name: CertError::CertError
methods.description: Constructor for CertError, initializing severity, ID, and parameters.

methods.name: CertError::ToDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string representation of the CertError.

methods.name: CertErrors::Add
methods.description: Adds a new CertError with specified severity, ID, and parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::AddError
methods.description: Adds a high severity error with specified ID and optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::AddWarning
methods.description: Adds a warning with specified ID and optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a concatenated debug string of all contained errors.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::GetErrorsForCert
methods.description: Retrieves errors associated with a specific certificate index.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ContainsError
methods.description: Checks if a specific error ID exists in any certificate or in general errors.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ToDebugString
methods.description: Generates a detailed debug string for all certificate errors and general errors.
